Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. Examination on initial
visit showed localized swelling, tenderness, and reduced grip strength in the affected wrist. Radiographs confirmed a distal radius
fracture, and the imaging findings and exam together clearly establish the injury. The patient reports no prior injury to this wrist
or surrounding area, and no earlier records of such a problem were available for review. Over five visits, the patient was managed
with immobilization, progressive range-of-motion work, and pain control. Recovery has been somewhat slower than typical for
this fracture pattern, and follow-up continues to mointor healing and function. Whether this specific injury resulted entirely from
the collision remains to be determined, and the mechanism is still under review. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges
for each service without duplication.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
